How to review your store on mobile

A focused walkthrough for finding friction on a small screen.

Start with navigation

Check that the menu fits the screen, can be closed easily and does not leave the page permanently locked. Test nested categories with touch and a keyboard.

Use realistic inputs

Enter a long email address, a long product name and the maximum allowed personalisation text. Open the software keyboard and check that the next action remains reachable.

Read the product page

Price, options, availability and delivery information should be understandable without guesswork. Product images need to remain clear at the sizes customers actually see.

Use real devices too

Browser resizing is useful, but it is not the same as testing on a phone. Include real iOS and Android devices before a significant launch.

Written for this portfolio. Adapt this checklist to your store, and verify changes before publishing.
